_about: Every model file Sound Forge can use, where it goes, and how big it is. `default: true` files are installed by `forge.py setup`; the rest are optional upgrades (`forge.py setup --all` or `forge.py models --install NAME`). Sizes are download sizes.

stable_audio_3_small_sfx.safetensors.role: sound effects and ambience (433M parameters, 44.1 kHz stereo, up to 120 s)
stable_audio_3_small_sfx.safetensors.license: Stability AI Community License: free for individuals and organisations under $1M annual revenue (register for commercial use); you own the outputs

stable_audio_3_small_music.safetensors.role: short music cues: stingers and UI jingles (433M parameters)

stable_audio_3_medium.safetensors.role: the `max` preset of sfx, ambience and stinger: 1.4B parameters, music and effects, up to 380 s; Stability reports about 6.5 GB peak VRAM

t5gemma_b_b_ul2.safetensors.role: text encoder for every Stable Audio 3 model
t5gemma_b_b_ul2.safetensors.license: Gemma terms of use (text encoder only)

acestep_v1.5_turbo.safetensors.license: MIT; the model card states generated music may be used commercially

qwen_1.7b_ace15.safetensors.role: ACE-Step 1.5 structure planner (writes the audio codes)

acestep_v1.5_xl_turbo_bf16.safetensors.role: optional bigger music model (4B); use with --set model=acestep_v1.5_xl_turbo_bf16.safetensors

qwen_4b_ace15.safetensors.role: optional bigger music planner; use with --set lm=qwen_4b_ace15.safetensors

Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-Tokenizer-12Hz.role: speech tokenizer shared by every Qwen3-TTS model

Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-VoiceDesign.role: creates a voice from a text description

Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-Base.role: speaks new lines in a saved character voice (cloning)

Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-0.6B-Base.role: smaller cloning model, used by the voice `fast` preset

laion/larger_clap_general.role: ranks candidate takes by how well they match the prompt (runs on the CPU)

8.summary: Everything runs at the standard preset. Music makes one take at a time and the voice model unloads after each line.
skip: stable_audio_3_medium.safetensors (fits - Stability reports 6.5 GB peak - but leaves no headroom; unmeasured)

12.summary: Everything, including the `max` presets with Stable Audio 3 Medium.

24.summary: Everything, plus room for the optional ACE-Step XL music model and its 4B planner.
